reason: The poll_feed_spec.rb tests always stub poll_feed with expects(:poll_feed). topic_retriever_spec.rb always mocks perform_retrieve, so fetch_http and TopicEmbed.import_remote (topic_embed.rb:364) never run, and the feed parsing at poll_feed.rb:270-284 is never tested. topic_embed_spec.rb only checks the basic case of turning a relative href/src into an absolute URL and a simple update, which leaves URL edge cases and the deleted-post update path uncovered, while CONTRIBUTING.md:42 says 'Include tests'.
